- **Investigate — “Static/interface checks” is undefined.** The harness facts identify the top module and testbench, but do not specify which static or interface checks run or what evidence passes them. Rewrite to name the checks and pass evidence, or remove this as a separate gate.
- **Investigate — “Synthesis … completes without unresolved synthesis errors” is vague.** The retained script promotes three message IDs to errors, but the contract does not define “unresolved” or the completion evidence. Rewrite with the harness’s synthesis completion and error evidence as the pass condition.

The timing, simulation, and advisory LUT criteria are testable as written.
